brief: Prioritize Kingsley Green for pre-event attention and bring forward its overdue detailed inspection in preference to accepting the exposure, as outlined in REG-042. Because the asset has an unverified cooling system and advanced age, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the heat event, following the guidance in MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified in accordance with MG-021.
